verdict.rationale: Mirrors is an SDK-based developer tool that captures and uploads agent session snapshots, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence only describes capture behavior ("Capture uploads a full snapshot in the background") and documents no switch to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Local routing and fallback-on-timeout are adjacent behaviors, not an opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
